details.description: Dhathri Kasthurimanjal wild turmeric face pack powder helps reduce tan, acne marks and blemishes.
details.usageInstructions: Mix with rose water or milk into a paste, apply on the face, leave until nearly dry and rinse.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.

details.description: Dhathri Aloe Vera Clear Gel with wheat germ oil and corn extract, a multipurpose gel for face, body and hair. Alcohol, paraben and silicone free.
details.usageInstructions: Apply a small amount on face, body or hair.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.

details.description: Dhathri Moisturising Aloe Vera Beauty Gel with rose and peppermint hydrates, soothes and refreshes face and body skin.
details.usageInstructions: Apply on clean skin and massage gently.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes.
